blocks.text: Morning all. Overnight run finished around 6. Same six devices as last week, the offline-sync conflict test plus the usual inspection flows.
Offline-sync conflict: the fix holds on 5 of 6. Same inspection edited on two devices while offline, then both back online. Both sets of edits land, findings intact, nothing overwritten.

The sixth is the old Android 11 tablet. It never got to the sync test: it crashes opening the camera, every time, so I couldn't start an inspection with photos on it. Looks like the same crash from the beta reports.
One other thing: one photo upload was flaky on the slow wifi profile. It stalled for a couple of minutes, then finished on its own. Didn't lose the photo. Noting it, not calling it a blocker yet.
I'll rerun the tablet at 8 in case anything's changed overnight.
